headline: Five-Star Business Finance reports 5% rise in Q2 net profit
hook: Loan book expands alongside steady profit growth
summary: Five-Star Business Finance reported a 4.61% year-on-year increase in net profit to ₹299 crore for the second quarter of FY27. Net interest income grew 11.5% year-on-year to ₹691 crore, driven by higher core lending margins. Assets under management expanded 14% to reach ₹14,640 crore, while first-half disbursements surged 44% to ₹3,574 crore. Indian retail investors tracking small-to-midcap non-banking financial companies can gauge loan growth momentum and credit demand trends in the secured MSME lending space.
why_it_matters: Stable earnings and steady AUM growth for the NBFC lender
winners_losers: Five-Star Business Finance gains / competitors neutral

headline: Five-Star Business Finance Q2 profit rises 5% on higher interest income
hook: Steady growth for Five-Star Business Finance
summary: Five-Star Business Finance reported a 5% increase in net profit for the second quarter, driven by growth in net interest income. The company's assets under management (AUM) expanded by 14% during the period. This performance reflects the lender's continued expansion in its core business segments. Retail investors should note the company's ability to maintain profitability while scaling its loan book.
why_it_matters: Reflects steady credit demand and margin management in the NBFC sector.
